description: Instrument the current protected 166700-neuron simulator to compute signed ORN and ALLN transmission into ALPN cells for the same left, right, uniform and sham trials; validate against the existing full-step numerical reference. This requires local code and runs.

Independently critique whether Olsen and Wilson 2008 supports a contralateral GABA/GluCl sign inversion in this model and identify primary experimental observations that distinguish antennal-lobe inhibition from downstream MB/LH pathways.

The current protected checkpoint has pending olfactory sensors [0,0,0]; an older PFG branch consumed nonzero values. Design a same-branch sham prestimulus control that can test a basal-state effect without changing biological parameters or calling any voltage state 'absolute zero'.

Diagnose a TypeSafe Jev Python client's HTTP 403 using recorded status/body and official API documentation, preserving authentication secrets and limiting network tests. A normal honest User-Agent was added, but the failure cause is not yet verified.
